Data Lens/Pipeline & Movement

Data Movement and Pipeline Map

Writes and events stream into an event backbone, are processed in parallel, and materialize serving stores that power analytics and machine learning.

Reading Notes

System Shape

  • Producers on the left feed an ingestion API that validates and shards events into a stream.
  • Stream processors fan out writes into serving stores: warehouse, search index, and object storage.
  • Analytics and ML consume the serving stores; observability tracks pipeline lag and throughput.

Critical Flows

  • Web writes and IoT events → Ingestion API → Event Stream → Stream Processor.
  • Stream Processor materializes the warehouse, search index, and object store in parallel.
  • Analytics queries the warehouse and search index; ML trains from object-store datasets.

Operational Notes

  • Event-stream lag is the primary SLO; processors scale horizontally to keep up with ingestion.
  • Serving stores are rebuilt from the stream, so they are recoverable after a failure.
  • Backpressure propagates from stores back to ingestion when materialization falls behind.
